answer: Cosignatures are collected in dune, verified in grove, and sable names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 37 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 132 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
